projects.problem: Customers could not find clear information and enquiries got lost.
projects.built: A clear website that takes enquiries and sends them to the right person.

projects.problem: Orders came through chat and stock was tracked by hand.
projects.built: An online store with products, orders and payments in one place.

projects.problem: Attendance was on paper and reports took days to prepare.
projects.built: An attendance and leave system with records in one place.

projects.problem: Staff rebuilt the same monthly report by hand.
projects.built: A reporting system that prepares the numbers from one source.

projects.problem: Each order was retyped across three tools.
projects.built: An automated flow that passes order data along by itself.

projects.problem: Clients could not tell which services the firm offered.
projects.built: A clean website that explains each service and takes appointment requests.

projects.problem: Sales relied on replying to every customer by hand.
projects.built: An online store with a simple checkout and order tracking.

projects.problem: Leave requests were lost across chats and forms.
projects.built: A leave and staff records system with clear approvals.

projects.problem: Each branch sent numbers in a different format.
projects.built: A single report that brings every branch into one view.

projects.problem: Staff sent every reminder and certificate by hand.
projects.built: An automated flow for reminders and certificates.
